workflow.name: NetBox devices CSV export
workflow.description: Fetch all NetBox devices and export them as a CSV report.

snippets.name: report
snippets.description: Generate a downloadable report (html/csv/xlsx/pdf) from a structured document. Set `format` + `document` in the node's config_overrides; downstream nodes read {{ steps.X.output.base64 }} and {{ steps.X.output.filename }} to email or upload it.

document.description: Report document (title, sections, tables…) matching the ReportDocument schema. Usually assembled from upstream output via {{ steps.X.output.… }} templates.

base64.description: Raw file bytes, base64-encoded — plug into a downstream email/upload node via {{ steps.X.output.base64 }}.

download_url.description: Relative API path to download the file.

snippets.name: netbox-devices-to-csv-rows
snippets.description: Transforms a NetBox JSON response into CSV report rows (name, IP, site, role, platform, status) and sanitizes residual templates in the input data.
snippets.logic_diagram_mermaid:
flowchart TD
    in(["Input: steps.fetch-netbox-devices.output"]) --> scrub["Sanitize strings containing template placeholder markers"]
    scrub --> extract["Read data.results"]
    extract --> loop{"For each device"}
    loop --> map["Map name, primary_ip4.address, site.name, role.name, platform.name, status.label"]
    map --> append["Append CSV row"]
    append --> loop
    loop -->|done| out(["Output: rows, row_count"])

snippets.name: fetch-netbox-devices-paginated
snippets.description: Fetches ALL NetBox devices by following pagination (offset-based) regardless of the server's enforced page size, and returns them in the same {data:{results,count}} shape the downstream CSV-rows step expects.
snippets.code:
from flowweaver_runtime import get_input, set_output, integration, log

MAX_PAGES = 500  # safety cap so a pagination bug can't loop forever


def scrub(value):
    # NetBox free-text fields (comments, description, ...) sometimes contain
    # literal '{{ ... }}' text (e.g. an unresolved Ansible/Jinja snippet a
    # human pasted in). The engine auto-injects this step's whole output into
    # every downstream python_snippet's input and then scans that input for
    # unresolved '{{ }}' templates BEFORE the downstream script runs - so a
    # literal '{{ }}' in NetBox data fails the downstream step before its own
    # code (even a scrub() there) ever executes. Sanitize here, at the
    # source, so no '{{ }}'-looking string ever leaves this step.
    if isinstance(value, str) and "{{" in value and "}}" in value:
        return "[scrubbed: contained template-like text]"
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [scrub(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: scrub(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


inp = get_input()
nb = integration("netbox")
path = "/api/dcim/devices/"

base_query = dict(inp.get("query") or {})
base_query.setdefault("limit", inp.get("page_limit", 1000))

all_results = []
offset = 0
total_count = None
page_size = None
pages = 0

while True:
    pages += 1
    if pages > MAX_PAGES:
        raise RuntimeError(f"aborted after {MAX_PAGES} pages fetching NetBox devices - safety cap hit")

    q = dict(base_query)
    q["offset"] = offset
    resp = nb.get(path, params=q)
    if not resp.ok:
        raise RuntimeError(f"NetBox HTTP {resp.status_code} at offset {offset}: {resp.text[:300]}")

    body = resp.json()
    results = body.get("results") or []
    all_results.extend(results)

    if total_count is None:
        total_count = body.get("count", len(results))
    if page_size is None:
        page_size = len(results) or int(base_query.get("limit") or 50)

    offset += page_size
    if not results or offset >= total_count:
        break

if total_count is not None and len(all_results) != total_count:
    log("warning", "fetched device count does not match NetBox reported count",
        fetched=len(all_results), netbox_count=total_count)

sanitized_results = scrub(all_results)

set_output({
    "data": {"results": sanitized_results, "count": total_count},
    "count": total_count,
    "row_count_fetched": len(all_results),
})

query.description: Extra NetBox query params (e.g. status filter)

page_limit.description: Requested page size; server may cap it lower

snippets.logic_diagram_mermaid:
flowchart TD
    in([Input: netbox_integration_id, query, page_limit]) --> req[GET /api/dcim/devices at offset 0]
    req --> ok{HTTP ok?}
    ok -->|no| fail([step FAILS with NetBox HTTP error])
    ok -->|yes| collect[Append page results; record count + page_size on first page]
    collect --> more{offset < NetBox count?}
    more -->|yes| req
    more -->|no| check{fetched == NetBox count?}
    check -->|no| warn[Log warning: count mismatch]
    check -->|yes| scrub[Recursively replace any string containing '{{ }}' with a safe placeholder]
    warn --> scrub
    scrub --> out([Output: data.results (sanitized), data.count, row_count_fetched])
